info.description:
Generated from openapi.json by `make postman` - do not edit by hand, the next regeneration overwrites it.

Getting started: set `base_url` (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1), send **Sign in** under Authentication, and every other request picks up the bearer token automatically.

The refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie, so it never appears in a response body; Postman's cookie jar replays it on /auth/refresh.

request.description:
One row per party and denomination in one aggregate query. Payables are aged from the invoice due date. Receivables have no invoice document in this schema, so they are netted out of the ledger oldest-first and aged from the posting date.

There is no exchange-rate table in this schema, so nothing here is summed across denominations. The response carries one block per currency the company has an open item in, and `currencies[0]` - the block whose figures are also restated at the top level - is `currency` if you asked for one, otherwise the company's own currency if anything is open in it, and failing that the currency with the most open documents. Blocks are ordered by open-document count, never by amount: two denominations cannot be compared by size without a rate this schema does not hold. Asking for nothing therefore returns the whole book, never an empty page.

`limit` is parties per denomination; each block reports `party_count` so a capped block is visible as capped, and its totals are the whole block's either way.

query.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. INR. Chooses which denomination's block is restated at the top level; every denomination is reported either way.
